title: rj_isa_diff v1 documents
description: Schemas for case.json (analyze), results.json (test), counterexample bundles and per-case JSONL log lines. Validate a document against #/$defs/<kind>; tools/isa_diff/docs/schema/validate_outputs.py does this for every file the CLI writes.

locs.description: Comma-separated location list in canonical order; empty for none.

target.description: A GPU RocJITsu executes (CDNA1-4, RDNA1-4, gfx1250/gfx1251).

callable_function.description: Present for a callable function (an STT_FUNC symbol without a kernel descriptor): entered by a call, left by s_setpc_b64 s[30:31]. At a return, the caller observes v0..v{return_vgprs-1}, the callee-saved SGPRs/VGPRs and EXEC.

return_sgprs.description: Graphics shader parts: s0..s{n-1} carry integer return values.

return_masks.description: Observed bits of each return VGPR (narrow return types).

inline_asm.description: Comment-only inline-asm blocks of a .s input inside the kernel/function, in address order (marked by the LLVM plugin).

before_label.description: A label follows: the block ends the preceding code.

entry_vgprs.description: VGPRs v0..v{n-1} defined at the entry (arguments, workitem IDs); others are undefined until written. -1: all defined.

entry_sgprs.description: SGPRs s0..s{n-1} defined at the entry; above them (except a callable function's callee-saved SGPRs), VCC, M0 and SCC are undefined until written. -1: all defined.

mattr.description: Target features passed to llc and llvm-mc.

inline_asm_blocks_marked.description: Comment-only inline-asm blocks marked in the assembled copy of the source.

provenance.description: Present only when a side came through the LLVM plugin (.ll/.s input).

inline_asm.description: A comment-only inline-asm block (no words): its index in the function's sequence of blocks, which pairs it with the other side's block, and its text.

contract.description: C(s_old,s_new) AND R_in => corresponding exits AND R_out AND frame preserved. Location sets use old naming; with entry_map/exit_map the new side receives inputs at entry_map(l) and is compared at exit_map(l).

memory_reads.description: A region instruction loads from memory (global_load_*, s_load_*); loads read one initial memory image shared by both sides. Absent when false.

memory_writes.description: A region instruction stores to memory (global_store_*); the stored bytes are an observable output. Absent when false.

downstream_memory_reads.description: Code after the region loads from memory, so a stored-byte difference can be compensated downstream. Absent when false.

inline_asm.description: The region contains comment-only inline-asm blocks: a def block writes per-case values (lanes in EXEC), equal for the old and new block with the same index; what use blocks observe is compared. Absent when false.

vgpr_undef_old.description: Live-in VGPRs undefined on the old side (never written since the entry): old's outputs that depend on them are don't care.

vgpr_undef_new.description: Live-in VGPRs undefined on the new side: new may not depend on them beyond old's don't-care bits.

exits.description: Regions with control flow: one entry per exit pair (pc 0: falling off the end of the region) with its own R_out.

exit_masks.description: Scalar locations observable only through a narrow return value (a shader's i8/i16 return in an SGPR): the bits compared.

exec_nonzero.description: EXEC at the entry is still the dispatch or call EXEC on every path, so it is not zero; inputs with EXEC 0 are invalid.

vgpr_active_lanes_only.description: Observable VGPRs compared on the lanes active in EXEC at the exit only: EXEC never changes after the exit, nothing reads an inactive lane again, and they are not callee-saved.

vgpr_exit_masks.description: VGPRs observable only through a narrow return value: the bits compared.

undef_old.description: Live-in scalar locations undefined on the old side (never written since the entry, not defined there).

undef_new.description: Live-in scalar locations undefined on the new side (never written since the entry, not defined there).

nan_tolerated.description: Valid pairs equal only through NaN equivalence.

undef_masked.description: Valid pairs equal only through undefined-bit masking.

memory_mismatch.description: Some mismatch included a stored-byte difference.

comparison.description: NaN policy (llvm: NaNs of floating-point results compare equal by format; strict: bitwise) and the poison filter in effect.

exit_pc.description: Where the run left a region with control flow (absent: it fell off the end).

memory.description: Memory model state: the initial-image seed, the initial words the case read (byte address of the word -> value), and the bytes this side stored (byte address -> byte).

inline_asm.description: Inline asm: the seed of def values, and what use blocks observed in execution order (per used 32-bit piece; VGPR pieces are 64 lanes with lanes outside EXEC zeroed, followed by EXEC lo/hi).

fp.description: Floating-point provenance after a run: per VGPR, one FpTag per lane (two hex digits each); per tagged scalar location, its FpTag; stored floating-point units [address, size, format].

counterexample.description: Self-contained bundle written by `test` (counterexamples/*.json); `replay` re-executes it.

memory_differs.description: The two sides stored different bytes, or stored to different addresses.

vgprs.description: Comma-separated VGPR list in register order; empty for none.
